steps.title: Connect the AI app: DCR + PKCE, consent page, passkey, allowance
Allowance installed onchain: amount and expiry for this AI app
wallet_overview: wallet balance and allowance are two numbers
paid_resource_fetch: buy the market brief for 0.10 over x402
Send Alice 2 USDC inside the allowance: payment_prepare → payment_execute
Ask for 20 USDC to Bob for dinner → needs your nod (approval link)
Owner opens the link, sees recipient and amount, nods with the passkey; the AI app polls
Same request again (same idempotency key) → same receipt, no second payment
Ask for 4 USDC with 2.90 left → needs your nod, not an onchain revert
Send Carol 5 USDC: trustline required → your nod → claim link → trust + transfer in one transaction
Owner revokes the AI app on the site → its next payment is refused, allowance gone onchain
Fee audit: Nod paid every network fee, the owner account holds no XLM
